name: Small and mid-scale modular LNG
principle: Packaged liquefaction trains of tens to hundreds of tonnes per day make LNG from pipeline gas or small fields for trucks, ships and remote power. Nitrogen expander cycles are favoured for simplicity and turndown; methane expansion and single mixed refrigerant cycles are alternatives.
